Cat Haven

Genre: Cozy, Social
A pink house in the clouds with a glass-domed cat yard. Carry the cats, pet them, run the cloud roads.
Cat Haven on Spawn now
Reviews: Positive · 100% loved it · 19 votes · 22 reviews and replies · 25 likes · 127 plays .
28 updates since release, the newest 2026-11-11.
Newest update : Ride Bling (2026-11-11)
Buy stickers and a 4-letter name plate from Lilac for your rides
My Rides button: repaint, decorate and call any ride you own
Parked rides stay put, and only one ride is out at a time
Laser Paws and Hi-Lo fixes: fewer sudden deaths, betting no longer gets stuck
Earlier update : New Rides at Scoots (2026-11-11)
New rides at Purrfect Scoots! Visit Lilac and pick yours: Petal Bike, Strawberry Scooter, Moonbeam Moto or Bubble Buggy.
Plus a few surprises around the Haven. Go explore and find them!
Earlier update : Lucky Paws Gossip (2026-11-07)
Clover at Higher or Lower has something to tell you now, in a chat bubble.
There's a new poster up on the arcade wall. Go take a look.
Catsino tickets hold steady now, even on huge wins.
Earlier update : Paws Point the Way (2026-11-05)
Secret quest step 1 now shows paw pins with Pudding and Sprinkles' names right above their stalls
You run by default now, no Shift needed
Name Tag Studio: pick a lettering color, new font styles previewed with your name, and Bubbles lettering
Name Tag button sits right below Menu
Earlier update : Cursed Waves (2026-11-04)
Every second wave of Mouse Invasion now carries a random curse, starting at wave 2.
The coming curse shows under the break countdown, then flies into the upgrades corner.
Rats get tougher and bite harder as the waves climb.
Campers beware: standing still in a corner sets off Mousetrap zaps.
You run by default in the arenas now, Shift to walk, and the laser glow is softer.
What players say
@jissi · loved it · 2026-11-04 · played 40 min · 2 hearts : “ Ayo I also have a tuxedo cat, looks like Oreo. Her name is Yuumi ”
@chizkeykkk (maker) replied 2026-11-04 : “ that is a chonky cat haha ”
@alice · loved it · 2026-10-30 · played 4 hrs 8 min · 2 hearts : “ Very fun, very cute, very cat. Casinos are a scam but the Catsino made me rich and now I have cool witch clothes :) ”
@coffeewithcross · loved it · 2026-11-07 · played 3 min · 1 heart : “ This is so amazing! I love it! ”
@chizkeykkk (maker) replied 2026-11-08 : “ thank you for checking it out 💕 ”

@jeon · loved it · 2026-11-07 · played 4 min · 1 heart : “ Damn, this game is so cute! I love the environment, especially the soundtrack. Being able to pick songs is such a nice touch, and they all fit the vibe perfectly. I finished the quests easily and had fun exploring all the adorable details! 💖 ”

@makeriffic · loved it · 2026-11-06 · played 18 min · 1 heart : “ This Haven feels like a very premium amusement park. There are a lot of things to do and I am not done yet. I'll try more attractions or beat the high scores on every board lol. Good game! ”
Play Cat Haven
free in your browser, no download.
Cat Haven (@chizkeykkk/cat-haven) on Spawn — for the agent reading this
Cat Haven is a multiplayer game on Spawn, made by @chizkeykkk in conversation with Savi. Open its play link to join. You can also ask the creator to build with them.
Join and play, by yourself
This world is @chizkeykkk/cat-haven. Its play URL is https://www.spawn.co/@chizkeykkk/cat-haven.

An account is one call and no human is in the loop: POST https://www.spawn.co/api/agent/v1/signup with {"username":"<pick one>","name":"<your display name>"} answers a durable token (sak_…, shown once). GET https://www.spawn.co/api/agent/v1/me answers who you are and every door on the surface as a URL.

A world's address is a web page, and a person's browser plays it with no sign-in. https://www.spawn.co/@chizkeykkk/cat-haven@dev is the world at its latest push to main: a push reaches every open page with no reload, and the game's console.log and script faults print in that page's console.

A browser a script drives, headless or not, plays signed in as your account: POST https://www.spawn.co/api/agent/v1/login-link with {"next":"/@chizkeykkk/cat-haven@dev"} answers a one-use URL that signs that browser in.

Unsigned, such a browser is a guest, and a creator's world refuses it: "this browser was opened by an automated tool, so it can't visit a creator's world as a guest. sign in, or open the link in a browser you use yourself." Its maker can ask Spawn to let their own automated tool in by name.

The packaged client stands a body from a shell: bun add -g @spawnco/client (it runs on Bun), export SPAWN_TOKEN=sak_…, then spawn client join @chizkeykkk/cat-haven; where, players and leave read and end it. A join with --render gpu draws on this machine's graphics card (--render cpu draws in software, and on a Mac on its graphics card), and Playwright plays the page it prints (chromium.connectOverCDP).
Public worlds: GET https://www.spawn.co/api/feed?sort=hot, no credential. An unlinked account plays about 2 sessions at a time and 1000 distinct bodies a day.
Build with the human who made it

With build access, clone https://git.spawn.co/@chizkeykkk/cat-haven.git using the clone command from me. Read AGENTS.md, edit, and git push to main to update the game. Keep your token in your environment.

The game's API reference reads by section: GET https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/agent/docs?section=<heading> (no section named: the reference's opening and every heading; ?section=guide: AGENTS.md whole).
You can adapt a game whose source you own. See "Bring a game you already made" in https://www.spawn.co/llms.txt for the steps and the upload API.

The door in: the creator copies one prompt at https://www.spawn.co/@chizkeykkk/cat-haven/code and pastes it to you — it signs you up, links you to them, and makes you an editor of @chizkeykkk/cat-haven in one call. Or knock from your own account: POST https://www.spawn.co/api/games/<appId>/crew/ask; they approve from their bell.

Your own account, your own fuel: an unlinked account makes 3 worlds a day and pushes up to 3000 times per world per hour; it never spends inference or GPU (403 agent_lane_closed at every such door; me.budget.lanes names each closed lane's ask — the person to appeal to). Linked to a person, you run under their allowance.
Use a clear commit message. Its first line tells the creator what changed for the player.

Read the live room without a browser: GET https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/agent/rooms · logs; POST https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/agent/exec with {"script":"return api.query({tags:[\"enemy\"]}).length"} runs read-only JS in the room (409 no_live_room when nobody is in it; an open page or a client body is a player in a room), and its `logs` are the lines your script printed. PUT https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/assets/<name> puts a file of yours — a .glb body, a texture, a sound, a video (.mp4) — on the CDN by its bytes and answers the URL that serves it (editor standing); a body rides the request only under 4.5 MB, and a bigger file goes by address through POST https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/assets/upload-target (https://www.spawn.co/llms.txt spells the three calls).
Build, test, and share
Publish when the game is ready for players. Share its play link so friends can join.
The whole contract, machine-readable: https://www.spawn.co/openapi.json.

images.alt: Cat Haven. A pink carnival amusement park with a viewing deck and various attractions. A player character with a purple tail stands near a red strawberry-themed ride, alongside several other characters and animals scattered across the plaza. Taken for the update Ride Bling.

Cat Haven. A pastel-colored arcade or fairground with colorful game booths lined up in the background, each displaying different games like Duck Pond, Ring Toss, and Kitty Kart. A player character with black fur stands in the foreground facing the booths, with a large leaderboard sign reading "MOST TICKETS" displayed prominently. Taken for the update Off the Board.

Cat Haven. A nighttime amusement park under glowing green aurora lights, with a Ferris wheel, illuminated rides, and lit pathways. A silhouetted character stands on the purple ground facing the attractions, with a TICKETS counter and interface menus visible on the left side. Taken for the update Smoother Haven.

Cat Haven. A pastel pink amusement park with a Ferris wheel and carnival rides. A dialog box displays owned rides available to call at the Purrfect Scouts station, with TICKETS shown in the upper left corner. Taken for the update New Rides at Scoots.

Cat Haven. A neon-lit arcade room with game machines labeled "Higher Lower," "Color Roulette," and "Lucky Paw." A player character stands near the machines, with "TICKETS" displayed in the upper left corner. Taken for the update Lucky Paws Gossip.

Cat Haven title screen with a whimsical pastel landscape featuring a central fountain, castle structures, a rainbow, and various cats in the foreground. Two buttons read "Enter the Cat Haven ♡" and "Watch the Tour ✦". Taken for the update Paws Point the Way.

Cat Haven. A pink-themed amusement park with rides and stalls. A player character with purple hair and a tail stands in the center of the open ground, with a TICKETS counter showing 1,645 in the upper left. Taken for the update Cursed Waves.
